from urls import canonical_url

class TestCanonicalUrl(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_basic_normalization(self):
        # Lowercase scheme and host, remove trailing slash
        self.assertEqual(canonical_url("HTTP://Example.COM/path/"), "http://example.com/path")

    def test_no_trailing_slash_root(self):
        # Root path should not lose trailing slash if it's just "/"
        self.assertEqual(canonical_url("https://example.com/"), "https://example.com/")

    def test_preserve_query(self):
        # Query must be preserved exactly
        self.assertEqual(canonical_url("http://example.com/page?a=1&b=2"), "http://example.com/page?a=1&b=2")

    def test_remove_fragment(self):
        # Fragment must be removed
        self.assertEqual(canonical_url("https://example.com/page#fragment"), "https://example.com/page")

    def test_complex_url(self):
        # Test all rules together
        url = "HTTP://ExAmPlE.COM/path/to/resource/?query=test#fragment"
        expected = "http://example.com/path/to/resource?query=test"
        self.assertEqual(canonical_url(url), expected)

    def test_only_host(self):
        # URL with only host (no path)
        self.assertEqual(canonical_url("http://example.com"), "http://example.com")

    def test_path_with_query_and_fragment(self):
        # Path with query and fragment
        url = "https://example.com/path?q=1#frag"
        expected = "https://example.com/path?q=1"
        self.assertEqual(canonical_url(url), expected)

    def test_non_string_input(self):
        # Reject non-strings
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Input must be a string."):
            canonical_url(123)

    def test_missing_host_or_scheme(self):
        # Reject missing host/scheme (e.g., just a path)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "URL must contain a scheme and host."):
            canonical_url("/path/to/resource")

    def test_invalid_scheme(self):
        # Reject other schemes
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Only http and https schemes are allowed."):
            canonical_url("ftp://example.com/file")

    def test_trailing_slash_on_root(self):
        # Ensure root path "/" is preserved as is (or normalized to itself)
        self.assertEqual(canonical_url("https://example.com/"), "https://example.com/")

    def test_no_trailing_slash_already(self):
        # Ensure no change if no trailing slash exists
        self.assertEqual(canonical_url("http://example.com/path"), "http://example.com/path")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()", "path": "candidate_tests.py"}}}]
